title: CAFEIN – Federated Learning Platform
summary: CERN describes operational federated model training and analysis across institutions, with intended benefits for research and privacy-preserving collaboration.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: CAFEIN uses federated averaging to train models across locally held datasets, with secure aggregation and privacy protections. CERN describes the platform as operationally used. Its intended benefit is collaborative model-assisted analysis without centralizing sensitive records. Analytical improvements and resulting patient outcomes are not quantified.
purpose: Support collaborative model-assisted research while keeping sensitive data local.

ratings.reason: Federated model training and analysis are described as operational, but an improvement in research output or analytical performance is not quantified.
Patient-care improvements are intended downstream effects of the model-assisted research.
More equitable access to collaborative AI research is intended but has not been measured.

ai_role.statement: Federated learning combines model updates from local datasets to support collaborative analysis; model inference is also planned.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: CAFEIN – Federated Learning Platform

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: CAFEIN trains research models without centralizing sensitive data
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
